text.tspan: Multiclass Cohen's κ = 0.786 Substantial agreement Observed agreement = 84.3% N = 5,140 6 categories

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.5px 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Binary reliability was computed using a one-vs-rest decomposition, where each category was treated as the positive class and all remaining categories as the negative class. Bootstrap uncertainty was estimated using 10,000 resamples.
